data.title: Anthropic and Bitcoin Are Both Falling: Where Is the Money Going?
data.description: Anthropic's blockbuster IPO stumbled on day two just as Bitcoin cracked below $60,000. The popular theory says crypto holders cashed out to buy the new stock, but the real money trail points somewhere far less exciting.
